title: C3 output - injury risk and explanation for one bowler session
description: Required fields are what C4 reads. Optional fields (added 18 Oct 2026, backward compatible) carry the two-level SHAP explanation shown on the C3 screen.

risk_score.description: Risk score on the scale shared with C4's tiers (0.30 / 0.55 / 0.75). Monotone map of probability_28d: alert probability (recall >= 0.80) -> 0.30, 2 x squad base rate -> 0.55, 4 x squad base rate -> 0.75.

top_factors.description: The three factors used in the narrative (raising factors first when the alert is on). Factor names reuse C2 feature names and C4 rule names.

shap.description: Contribution in risk-score units; the factors add up to risk_score - base_score

shap_logodds.description: Raw TreeSHAP value in calibrated log-odds

reliable.description: Kinematic factors: false if any C2 value came from a camera view C1/C2 mark as unreliable

explanation.description: One plain-language sentence (+ reliability caveat if needed)

risk_tier.description: Same tiers and cut-offs as C4

probability_28d.description: Calibrated probability of a time-loss injury in the next horizon_days

modality_attribution.description: Level-1 SHAP: total contribution of each modality

all_factors.description: Level-2 SHAP for every factor, with its model features as components
